$comment: GlowThread design tokens: the one source for src/design/tokens.css and the token tables in docs/theming.md and docs/zh-CN/theming.md. Edit this file, then run `pnpm tokens css` and `pnpm tokens docs`. Each token is the public custom property --glowthread-<name>. Tokens with a night value also read --glowthread-night-<name> in night mode. `phone` is added to the base value below 640 px (`phoneMedia` when the step must keep another media query), `phoneOf` marks a token that replaces that phone value. `at` resolves the token on another element than the scope roots and container parts. `lang` gives other defaults by interface language. `shown` and `zhShown` describe a long default in the docs tables.

groups.title: Colours
groups.note: Contrast targets: text colours (`fg`, `fg-muted`, `fg-subtle`, `accent-text`) need 4.5:1 on `surface` and on your page background. `accent` and `border-control` need 3:1. Status colours need 4.5:1 on their own `-subtle` ground. `on-accent` needs 4.5:1 on `accent-bg`. Check your values in light and night mode.
groups.zhNote: 对比度要求：文字颜色（`fg`、`fg-muted`、`fg-subtle`、`accent-text`）在 `surface` 和你的页面背景上需要达到 4.5:1。`accent` 和 `border-control` 需要 3:1。状态颜色在各自的 `-subtle` 底色上需要 4.5:1。`on-accent` 在 `accent-bg` 上需要 4.5:1。请在浅色和夜间模式下都检查你的取值。
